company.name: Willow
company.shortDescription: Willow is a contract management software.
company.description: Willow is the next generation of contract management software. Contracts have become an increasingly essential part of any business, and the lawyers, contract managers, or business people tasked with managing them are overwhelmed with data and underwhelmed by existing solutions. Willow's mission is to make managing contracts as simple and straightforward as possible, using modern software and technology. Instead of using endless spreadsheets or software from the last century designed for huge enterprises, Willow makes managing contracts easy and accessible for modern business.
